integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only the projective-line decomposition of the quadratic field, the one-dimensional trace kernel, and character orthogonality on the quotient. Finite-field code checks those structural premises and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to \(K=\mathbb F_{p^2}\), \(m\ge4\) with \(m\mid p+1\) and \(m<p+1\).
Only nontrivial characters trivial on \(\mathbb F_p^\times\) are classified.
An unindexed equivalent formulation in relative Gauss-sum language remains a residual originality risk.
title: A subfield-trivial character forces monomial compressed Fourier transforms in quadratic fields
